name: Ink plume curls into a bird, then dissolves
looks: A monochrome plume of smoke or ink billows up the frame, and for a moment its drifting form reads as a bird's head and wing before dissolving back into abstract wisps. A thin accent line traces alongside it like a flight path, a small accent dot riding its tip.
build: Fluid/smoke sim driven toward a bird-silhouette mask at its peak-legibility frame, then released back to free drift. The accent line is a separate hand-eased path kept crisp against the organic smoke noise; rendered in ink-on-paper monochrome, colour reserved for the line and dot only.
sound: A very soft, low whoosh under the plume's motion, nothing percussive.
prompt: Billow a monochrome plume of smoke or ink up the frame, letting it drift through a moment where it reads as a recognisable creature or shape before dissolving back into abstraction, with one thin accent line and dot tracing alongside it like a path, on an otherwise quiet, restrained palette.
